title: Baby Held Outdoors, 1939 Regina Saskatchewan Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: 6 weeks old. 105 JUN 26 1939 MIDLAND POSTAL PHOTO SUPPLIES REGINA, SASK.
description: A candid black and white snapshot photograph from 1939 showing a six-week-old baby wearing a white bonnet, held outside a home in Regina, Saskatchewan. The back of the photo features handwritten text stating '6 weeks old.', a developer stamp from Midland Postal Photo Supplies in Regina, and a photofinishing date stamp of June 26, 1939.
